description: DAO-LIFE: a Clone is read after its source dynaset is closed, and the source is closed again. A snapshot from QueryDef QSel is read after QueryDef.Close, and the QueryDef's SQL is read. A held TableDef is read after the Database variable is released. A held Database is read after the DBEngine variable is released. A pending Edit on a writable dynaset is held across Database.Close (EditMode read after), and row 1 is read back through a fresh read-only open. Errors after each phase.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
